title: Flutter Run & Debug (FlutterRun) Debug Adapter Configuration
description: Configuration of one FlutterRun entry in .zed/debug.json. Unknown keys are allowed on purpose: Dart-Code launch.json entries can be pasted without edits, and the Dart/Flutter debug adapter ignores keys it does not know. Each property's x-support says who handles it: implemented (this extension or its flutter_run proxy), passthrough (forwarded to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter) or ignored (accepted, no effect).
markdownDescription:
Configuration of one `FlutterRun` entry in `.zed/debug.json`.

`additionalProperties` stays `true` on purpose: Dart-Code `launch.json` entries can be pasted without edits, and the Dart/Flutter debug adapter ignores keys it does not know.

Each property's `x-support` says who handles it: `implemented` (this extension or its `flutter_run` proxy), `passthrough` (forwarded to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter) or `ignored` (accepted, no effect).

adapter.description: Selects this debug adapter. Must be FlutterRun.
adapter.markdownDescription: Selects this debug adapter. Must be `FlutterRun`. Stripped by the `flutter_run` proxy before the config reaches the Dart/Flutter debug adapter.

label.description: Name shown in the Zed debug picker.
label.markdownDescription: Name shown in the Zed debug picker (F4). Stripped by the proxy before the config reaches the adapter.

request.description: launch starts the app with flutter run (or dart for type dart); attach connects to an app that is already running.
request.markdownDescription: `launch` starts the app (`flutter run` or `dart`). `attach` connects to an app that is already running. Pass `vmServiceUri` (required for `type: dart`); without it a Flutter attach waits for an app to start on the device (the proxy warns after 15 s).

type.description: flutter debugs a Flutter app (flutter debug_adapter); dart debugs a plain Dart program (dart debug_adapter).
type.markdownDescription: `flutter` debugs a Flutter app through `flutter debug_adapter`. `dart` debugs a plain Dart program (for example `bin/main.dart` or a test) through `dart debug_adapter`. The device settings only apply to `flutter`.

program.description: Dart file to run, relative to cwd. Launch only; ignored for attach. Defaults to lib/main.dart for Flutter launches.
program.markdownDescription: Dart file to run, relative to `cwd`. **Launch only**: ignored for `attach`. The proxy fills in `lib/main.dart` for Flutter launches when it is empty. Use a different entry such as `lib/main_dev.dart` for flavors.

cwd.description: Working directory of the app. Defaults to the worktree root; a relative path is resolved against it.
cwd.markdownDescription: Working directory of the app. Defaults to the worktree root; a relative path is resolved against the worktree root (not against Zed's own directory).

args.description: Arguments for the Dart program itself (after the program name).
args.markdownDescription: Arguments for your Dart program (what `main(List<String> args)` receives). Tool options such as `--flavor` belong in `toolArgs`.

toolArgs.description: Extra options for flutter run / flutter attach (or dart), for example ["--flavor", "dev"]. The proxy adds -d, --profile or --release here when needed.
toolArgs.markdownDescription:
Extra options for `flutter run` / `flutter attach` (or the `dart` tool for `type: dart`), one array element per word.

The proxy appends `-d <deviceId>` and `--profile` / `--release` here unless you already set them.

env.description: Environment variables for the proxy and the app. They override the shell environment of the worktree.
env.markdownDescription: Environment variables for the proxy and the app. Values override the shell environment of the worktree; on Windows names are case-insensitive. Numbers and booleans are accepted and converted to text.

flutterMode.description: Build mode for launch: debug, profile or release. Adds --profile or --release to toolArgs unless toolArgs already picks a mode.
flutterMode.markdownDescription: Build mode for **launch**. `profile` and `release` add `--profile` / `--release` to `toolArgs`, unless `toolArgs` already selects a mode.

deviceId.description: Device id from flutter_run devices (for example linux, chrome, emulator-5554). The proxy adds -d <id> unless toolArgs already has a device.
deviceId.markdownDescription: Device id as shown by `flutter_run devices` or `flutter devices`. The proxy adds `-d <id>` unless `toolArgs` already selects a device. Without it, the proxy tries `FLUTTER_RUN_DEVICE`, then the device saved by *Flutter: Select Device*.

platform.description: Accepted so Dart-Code launch.json entries can be pasted; the value is ignored. Use deviceId.
platform.markdownDescription: Accepted so Dart-Code `launch.json` entries can be pasted; the value is **ignored**. Use `deviceId` instead.

vmServiceUri.description: VM service address of the running app (request attach). Printed by flutter run, for example http://127.0.0.1:50123/abc=/.
vmServiceUri.markdownDescription: VM service address of the running app. **Recommended for `attach`**, and required for `type: dart` unless `vmServiceInfoFile` is set. Without it a Flutter attach waits for an app to appear; Zed's modal "attach" cannot ask for it. `flutter run` prints it as *A Dart VM Service ... is available at: ...*.

vmServiceInfoFile.description: JSON file with {"uri": "ws://..."} (request attach). The plain-text file of flutter run --vmservice-out-file does not work; use vmServiceUri.
vmServiceInfoFile.markdownDescription: Path of a JSON file such as `{"uri": "ws://127.0.0.1:50123/abc=/ws"}`. The bare-string file written by `flutter run --vmservice-out-file` does **not** work (the adapter waits forever); use `vmServiceUri` instead.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause at the first line of the program.

noDebug.description: Run without a debugger attached (no breakpoints).

debugSdkLibraries.description: Step into and show Dart SDK libraries (dart:*) while debugging. Forwarded to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter unchanged.

debugExternalPackageLibraries.description: Step into and show code from packages outside your project. Forwarded to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter unchanged.

evaluateGettersInDebugViews.description: Call getters to show their values in Variables and Watch. Forwarded to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter unchanged.

evaluateToStringInDebugViews.description: Call toString() to show readable values in Variables and Watch. Forwarded to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter unchanged.

sendLogsToClient.description: Send the debug adapter's own log to Zed as DAP output events. Forwarded to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter unchanged.

useFvm.description: Require the Flutter SDK chosen by FVM for this project; fails with a clear message when FVM has no SDK there.
useFvm.markdownDescription: Require the SDK selected by FVM (`.fvm/flutter_sdk` or `.fvmrc`). When on, only FVM sources are used and the launch fails with a clear message if FVM has no SDK. Run `fvm use` in the project to fix it.

flutterSdkPath.description: Flutter SDK root folder. First step of SDK resolution, before FVM and PATH.
flutterSdkPath.markdownDescription: Flutter SDK root folder (the one that contains `bin/flutter`). First step of SDK resolution, before FVM and `PATH`.

reloadOnSave.description: Hot reload on save: changed (only if a watched file changed), always (every save), off.
reloadOnSave.markdownDescription: Hot reload when you save: `changed` reloads only when file contents changed, `always` reloads on every save, `off` disables it. Watches `lib/` and the folders of `reloadOnSaveGlobs`.

reloadOnSaveGlobs.description: Extra globs, relative to the project, that also trigger a reload. Each must start with a folder, for example assets/**.json.
reloadOnSaveGlobs.markdownDescription: Extra globs, relative to the project, that also trigger a reload. Each must start with a folder name because only those folders are watched.

reloadOnSaveDebounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last change before reloading (10 to 5000).

openDevTools.description: Page to open in the browser when the app starts; never does nothing. Needs DDS, so it does not work with --no-dds.
openDevTools.markdownDescription: Page to open in the browser when the app starts (`never` opens nothing). The proxy builds the URL from the DDS-served DevTools, so it does not work with `--no-dds`.

logFile.description: File that receives the proxy's debug log and all DAP traffic. Off by default; may contain source paths.
